title: Potato and Mushroom Burekas
subtitle: in crisp filo rolls
description: Filo rolls filled with mashed potato and portobello mushrooms cooked with onion, coriander seed and cumin.

steps.text: Peel the potatoes, boil and mash them. Season with salt and pepper and leave to cool.
Thinly slice the mushrooms and onion and saute with the spices and olive oil until the liquid has fully evaporated. Leave to cool.
Brush two filo sheets with olive oil and stack them. Cut into rectangles 20 cm long and 10 cm wide.

Place a strip of mashed potato across the bottom of the pastry (you can use a piping bag) and top with the onion and mushroom mixture. Roll into a log and place seam side down on a tray. Repeat with the remaining filo sheets.
Brush with olive oil, sprinkle with sesame seeds and bake at 180-190°C until browned.
